#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;

long long powmod(long long x, long long y) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (y > 0) {
        if (y & 1) res = (res * x) % MOD;
        x = (x * x) % MOD;
        y >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

long long choose(int a, int b, const vector<long long>& fact, const vector<long long>& invFact) {
    if (b < 0 || b > a) return 0;
    return fact[a] * invFact[b] % MOD * invFact[a - b] % MOD;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    int N;
    long long pk;
    cin >> N >> pk;
    if (pk > N - 1) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    int k = (int)pk;
    int c = N - k;

    vector<long long> fact(N + 1), invFact(N + 1);
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
        fact[i] = (i * fact[i - 1]) % MOD;
    }
    invFact[N] = powmod(fact[N], MOD - 2);
    for (int i = N - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
        invFact[i] = (invFact[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % MOD;
    }

    long long ans = 0;
    int sign = 1;
    for (int i = c; i >= 0; --i) {
        long long term = (choose(c, i, fact, invFact) * powmod(i, N)) % MOD;
        if (sign == 1) {
            ans = (ans + term) % MOD;
        } else {
            ans = (ans - term + MOD) % MOD;
        }
        sign = -sign;
    }
    ans = (ans * choose(N, c, fact, invFact)) % MOD;
    if (k > 0) {
        ans = (2 * ans) % MOD;
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
